title: Automated Synthesis of Cloud Emulators
abstract: arXiv:2608.23842v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: DevOps programming (e.g., using CLI/API scripts or IaC frameworks) is key to cloud infrastructure management. Unlike traditional programming tasks, DevOps program testing needs provisioning and execution against actual cloud resources, which is often time-consuming, unsafe, and costly. Cloud emulators have gained popularity for easing DevOps program testing; they are generally API-level mocks that can execute DevOps programs in a local environment. Still, building these emulators remains challenging: developers must manually interpret extensive cloud documentation and handcraft logic for each service, API, and their interaction. This does not scale to the complexity of the cloud, which is further a moving target as the services and APIs evolve. translated_title: 云模拟器的自动化合成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23842v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：DevOps编程（例如，使用CLI/API脚本或IaC框架）是云基础设施管理的关键。与传统编程任务不同，DevOps程序测试需要针对实际云资源进行配置和执行，这通常耗时、不安全且成本高昂。云模拟器因简化DevOps程序测试而日益流行；它们通常是API级别的模拟器，能在本地环境中执行DevOps程序。然而，构建这些模拟器仍然具有挑战性：开发者必须手动解读大量云文档，并为每个服务、API及其交互手工编写逻辑。这无法扩展到云的复杂性，而且随着服务和API的演进，云是一个不断变化的目标。CloudEmu是一种自动化方法，通过神经符号代码合成基于云文档构建模拟器。其关键思想是结合LLMs在文档理解方面的通用优势。
tldr: 本文提出CloudEmu，一种利用神经符号代码合成自动从云文档构建云模拟器的方法，以解决手动构建模拟器的可扩展性和维护难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CloudEmu, an automated approach that constructs cloud emulators from cloud documentation via neurosymbolic code synthesis, addressing the scalability and maintenance challenges of manually building emulators.
